! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Module 4 : PYTHIA 8 hard QCD (dijets) in pp at sqrt(s) = 13 TeV
!
!   python scripts/m02_run_pythia.py --card generators/pythia_hardqcd_13TeV.cmnd \
!          --out data/generated/m04_hardqcd_13TeV.root
!
! Same tune, PDF, primary definition and seed convention as the minimum-bias
! card (pythia_mb_13TeV.cmnd); only the PROCESS changes.  Every setting that
! matters is written out, default or not.
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

! --- beams -------------------------------------------------------------------
Beams:idA = 2212
Beams:idB = 2212
Beams:eCM = 13000.               ! GeV

! --- process: all 2 -> 2 QCD processes ---------------------------------------
SoftQCD:inelastic = off
HardQCD:all = on                 ! gg->gg, qg->qg, qq->qq, gg->qqbar, ...
PhaseSpace:pTHatMin = 20.        ! GeV: hard-scattering pT cut.  Jets below
                                 ! ~30 GeV are BIASED by it (ISR/FSR and MPI
                                 ! smear the jet pT around pTHat) -- the
                                 ! analysis only trusts jets well above it.
                                 ! Events are unweighted; sigma_gen in the
                                 ! provenance converts counts to a cross section.

! --- tune and PDF (as in the minimum-bias card) --------------------------------
Tune:pp = 14                     ! Monash 2013
Tune:ee = 7
PDF:pSet = 13                    ! NNPDF2.3 QCD+QED LO

! --- underlying event and hadronization ON: these are particle-level jets ----
PartonLevel:MPI = on             ! the underlying event that jet areas measure
PartonLevel:ISR = on
PartonLevel:FSR = on
HadronLevel:Hadronize = on
HadronLevel:Decay = on
ColourReconnection:reconnect = on

! --- primary particles, ALICE-style (Module 2) --------------------------------
ParticleDecays:limitTau0 = on
ParticleDecays:tau0Max = 10.     ! mm/c

! --- random numbers ----------------------------------------------------------
Random:setSeed = on
Random:seed = 20260827

! --- run control (Print:quiet BEFORE Next:*, troubleshooting #14) -------------
Print:quiet = off
Main:numberOfEvents = 5000
Main:timesAllowErrors = 10
Next:numberCount = 1000
Next:numberShowInfo = 0
Next:numberShowProcess = 0
Next:numberShowEvent = 0
